svg.title: Index the place. Preserve the uncertainty.

cc:Work.dc:title: Index the place. Preserve the uncertainty.
cc:Work.dc:description: Measured summer-2024 station mean TMAX: 43.5 °C · all canopy, albedo, material, and utility geometry below are synthetic H3 coordinates from the pinned NOAA station location. East/north offsets use a local approximation, not a survey CRS. Heat scenario assumes 700 W/m² solar forcing and 25 W/(m²·K) heat transfer; no evapotranspiration, radiation exchange, or observed street-temperature validation.
